name: Android CI

on:
  push:
    branches: ["main"]
  pull_request:
    branches: ["main"]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: android-ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  JAVA_VERSION: '17'
  GRADLE_OPTS: -Dorg.gradle.daemon=false -Dorg.gradle.jvmargs=-Xmx2g

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build downloadable debug APK
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Set up JDK
        uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          java-version: ${{ env.JAVA_VERSION }}
          distribution: temurin
          cache: gradle

      - name: Grant execute permission to Gradle wrapper
        run: chmod +x ./gradlew

      - name: Build debug APK
        run: ./gradlew --no-daemon --stacktrace --console=plain :app:assembleDebug

      - name: Verify APK was created
        run: |
          apk_count=$(find app/build/outputs/apk/debug -type f -name '*.apk' | wc -l)
          if [ "$apk_count" -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "No debug APK was produced."
            exit 1
          fi
          ls -lh app/build/outputs/apk/debug/*.apk

      - name: Upload downloadable debug APK
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v5
        with:
          name: Calculator-debug-apk-${{ github.run_number }}
          path: app/build/outputs/apk/debug/*.apk
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
